card_text: Full car workshop in Defu Industrial Estate, mainly passenger cars.
Servicing, engine and gearbox repairs, aircon and accident claims.
lede: Hon Win Motor is a car workshop at 6 Defu Lane 10 in Defu Industrial Estate, Hougang. It services and repairs mainly passenger cars: Japanese, Korean and Continental, petrol and hybrid. Work covers servicing, engine, electrical and gearbox repairs, aircon, and accident repairs with insurance claims. A quote is given before any work starts. WhatsApp or call 9171 8466.

services.d: Engine oil and oil filter, an OBD diagnostic scan, fluid top-ups and a full safety check. Spark plugs and gearbox oil are changed only if needed.
Warning lights, starting and battery faults, alternators, starter motors, lamps, wiring, water pumps and turbos, up to top and full engine overhauls.
Automatic, manual, CVT and DCT gearboxes repaired and overhauled in-house.
Gas top-up and leak check, cooling coil replacement, and compressor, condenser and blower repairs.
Accident repairs and body work, with help on the insurance claim. WhatsApp photos of the damage first.
Front and rear dash cams, parking mode wiring, reverse cameras, parking sensors and head units.

price_note: Prices depend on the car and the job. The workshop gives a quote before any work starts.
hours_note: Hours from its Google Business Profile (checked November 2026). WhatsApp before you visit on a public holiday.

faqs: Which cars does Hon Win Motor work on?
Mainly passenger cars: Japanese, Korean and Continental, petrol and hybrid. Its website also names Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Porsche and Volvo, and diesel vehicles.
Walk-ins are welcome. WhatsApp 9171 8466 first to check the workshop is free.
Will I know the price before work starts?
Yes. The car is checked first and a quote is given before any work starts.
My car cannot be driven. What do I do?
WhatsApp or call 9171 8466. Towing is free when the repair is done at the workshop.
Cash, scan to pay, bank transfer, or Atome instalments.
